integrity_notes: Exact arbitrary-length proof is combinatorial. The standalone program independently checks exhaustive finite cases; its finite search is not used as a proof of the infinite formulas. The presented review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The transfer applies only to internally vertex-disjoint two-terminal path networks with each path length at least two. The binomial closed form and cardinality gaps are restricted to paths of length exactly three. Other closure conventions and broader graph classes are not included; historical priority is not exhaustive.
title: Size-refined \(P_3\)-convexity of generalized theta graphs and sharp cardinality gaps
